subject: Re: Infinite Nature kickoff - staffing + the June TPU week
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Umar 50%, Kaia 40%, Oyin 50%; Farah 40% on serving integration through May (June is tight for her, so serving needs to be functionally done by end of May - noted in the plan).
- Compute: repro and iteration on 24 titan-a100 best-effort. For the final full retraining run on the licensed corpus, we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation - 128 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-08 - out of the vision portfolio's quarterly allocation. That lands the retrained checkpoint about a week before the June 22 demo freeze, with the intervening days for eval and demo integration. It's tight but deliberate: earlier weeks would mean retraining on an unfinished corpus.
- One build annoyance: the differentiable renderer (tf_mesh_renderer) needs the gcc build path rather than Bazel to work with TF 2.x, plus the release's compatibility patch. Oyin has it building reproducibly in a container now.

Budget fits the portfolio envelope; no headcount ask.

Deshawn
